feedback.problem: Let $p=i-3j$ and $q=xi+2j+k.$ Given that the scalar projection of $p$ onto $q$ is $0,$ find the value of $x.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Since $p$ is a nonzero vector, its scalar projection onto another nonzero vector $q$ equals zero only when the vectors are perpendicular. 

So, we must have

$$
p⊥q\,⟹\,p\cdot q=0.
$$

Computing the dot product, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}p\cdot q & ={p}_{x}\cdot {q}_{x}+{p}_{y}\cdot {q}_{y}+{p}_{z}\cdot {q}_{z} \\  & =1\cdot x+(-3)\cdot 2+0\cdot 1 \\  & =x-6.\end{aligned}
$$

Setting the dot product equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}p\cdot q & =0 \\ x-6 & =0 \\ x & =6.\end{aligned}
$$
